assignments.package_label_en: The Evil Inclination and the Wicked Kingdom
assignments.reason: The subjugation of the yetzer hara (הכנעת היצר הרע) is essentially a concept belonging to the domain of the evil inclination — it describes what happens TO the yetzer hara. Its essential nature is the evil force being overcome. While Torah is the cause that produces this subjugation (eitza: תורה → הכנעת היצר הרע), the concept itself is defined by what it acts upon: the yetzer hara. It belongs in the evil package as the description of the evil kingdom's defeat, alongside שגעון and רוח שטות which describe the yetzer hara's effects.

assignments.node_id: כדי שיאיר לו השכל, שיש בכל דבר, להתקרב להשם יתברך על ידי אותו הדבר
assignments.node_text: כְּדֵי שֶׁיָּאִיר לוֹ הַשֵֹּכֶל, שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּכָל דָּבָר, לְהִתְקָרֵב לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל - יְדֵי אוֹתוֹ הַדָּבָר
assignments.reason: This node describes the illumination of the sekhel (intellect) within every thing, enabling one to draw close to God through that thing. Its essential nature IS the sekhel/chokhmah — it is the active expression of wisdom illuminating one's path. The source text (line 4) states: 'כְּדֵי שֶׁיָּאִיר לוֹ הַשֵּׂכֶל שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּכָל דָּבָר לְהִתְקָרֵב לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ' — this is the purpose and function of chokhmah itself. It belongs in Package 1 alongside להסתכל בהשכל שיש בכל דבר and הסתכלות, which describe the same wisdom-domain from different angles.

assignments.package_label_en: The Evil Inclination and the Wicked Kingdom
assignments.reason: This node describes the falling and annulment of the wicked kingdom (מלכות הרשעה). Its essential nature is the evil kingdom — it is a state-description of what happens to the evil malkhut. The source text (line 14): 'וַאֲזַי נוֹפֵל וְנִתְבַּטֵּל מַלְכוּת הָרְשָׁעָה'. Even though holy malkhut (Package 2) is the cause of this fall, the concept itself is entirely about the evil kingdom. It belongs in Package 3 alongside מלכות הרשעה, which it directly describes.

assignments.node_id: נותן כח למלכות דקדשה בחינת נו"ן, לקבל מן השכל, שהוא בחינת חי"ת
assignments.node_text: נוֹתֵן כֹּחַ לַמַּלְכוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה בְּחִינַת נוּ"ן, לְקַבֵּל מִן הַשֵֹּכֶל, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת חֵי"ת
assignments.reason: This node describes the empowerment of holy malkhut (the nun) to receive from the sekhel (the chet). Its essential nature is the mechanism of holy kingship receiving — it IS the process of malkhut d'kedusha gaining strength. The source text (line 34): 'נוֹתֵן כֹּחַ לַמַּלְכוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה בְּחִינַת נוּ"ן, לְקַבֵּל מִן הַשֵּׂכֶל, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת חֵי"ת'. While Torah causes this empowerment, the concept itself is about malkhut receiving — it belongs in Package 2 alongside מלכות, אות נו"ן, and דלית לה מגרמה כלום, all of which describe the receiving nature of holy kingship.

assignments.node_id: נחקק ונרשם מקום בלב המתבקש לקבל הבקשה
assignments.node_text: נֶחְקָק וְנִרְשָׁם מָקוֹם בְּלֵב הַמִּתְבַּקֵּשׁ לְקַבֵּל הַבַּקָּשָׁה
assignments.package_label_en: The Letter Tav and the Engraving
assignments.reason: This node describes the engraving and marking of a place in the heart of the one being petitioned to accept the request. Its essential nature is engraving/imprinting (חקיקה ורשימה) — the very domain of Package 5. The source text (line 17-18): 'כִּי עַל־יְדֵי הַחֵן נֶחְקָק וְנִרְשָׁם מָקוֹם בְּלֵב הַמִּתְבַּקֵּשׁ לְקַבֵּל הַבַּקָּשָׁה... וְהַחֲקִיקָה וּרְשִׁימָה זֶה בְּחִינַת תָּ"ו'. While חן (grace, Package 2) causes this engraving, the concept itself IS the engraving — the seal/impression domain. It belongs with אות ת"ו, חקיקה, and רשימה.

The acceptance of prayers and petitions (קבלת התפלות) is the ultimate outcome of the chen/malkhut process. Its essential nature is the domain of grace and favor — prayers being accepted is what chen (grace) produces and what malkhut d'kedusha enables. The source text opens (line 2): 'עַל יְדֵי הַתּוֹרָה נִתְקַבְּלִים כָּל הַתְּפִלּוֹת... וְהַחֵן וְהַחֲשִׁיבוּת שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל נִתְעַלֶּה'. Prayer acceptance and chen/chashivut are presented as one unified outcome. While Torah is the ultimate cause, the concept of accepted prayers belongs to the domain of grace and kingship — the receptive quality that allows words to enter the heart. It is not Torah itself (which is the instrument), but the fruit of the malkhut-chen dynamic.

alias_notes.reason: ת"ו in edge 3065 is a shortened form of אות ת"ו which is already in Package 5 (אוֹת תָּ"ו וְהַחֲקִיקָה). This is an alias, not a new unassigned node. The edge (חן → ת"ו) represents the eitza connection: grace produces the tav/engraving.
